desc: query networking state of the running system
u: netplan-status - query networking state of the running system

netplan status [interface] queries the current network configuration and displays it in human readable format.

You can specify interface to display the status of a specific interface.

Currently, netplan status depends on systemd-networkd as a source of data and will try to start it if it's not masked.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Print basic help.</dd><dt data-o="">--debug</dt><dd>Print debugging output during the process.</dd><dt data-o="">-a, --all</dt><dd>Show all interface data including inactive</dd><dt data-o="">-f FORMAT, --format FORMAT</dt><dd>Output in machine readable json or yaml format</dd></dl>
